title: Gender Inequality in English Textbooks Around the World: an NLP Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the occurrence count and firstness (order of appearance) of gendered terms, extracting gender-associated words using TF-IDF, counting gendered names in different contexts, testing LLM recognition of gender-specific word lists, and calculating the cosine distance of these words to specific semantic keywords in GloVe vector space.
